title: Welcome to PULSE - The Heartbeat of Our Company!
body: We are extremely excited to officially roll out **PULSE**, our new internal culture and engagement layer. PULSE is designed to break down corporate silos, celebrate people, and keep everyone aligned on our company vision. Enjoy peer kudos, read leadership updates, and connect with your colleagues across all offices!

title: Vulnerability Warning: Immediate Action Required on Local Development
body: It looks like a critical vulnerability has been reported in a popular dependency. All software engineers must immediately run `npm audit` on their local development environments and ensure that dependencies are patched to their latest stable configurations. Please coordinate with SRE if you encounter any build breakages.

title: Wellness Week 2026 & Fitness Challenge Launch
body: Get ready for a week of health, focus, and fun! Starting next Monday, we will host yoga workshops, mindfulness sessions, and a daily step challenge with exciting prizes. Yoga sessions will be led virtually by our own Chief People Officer, Arjun Rao. Check the Events tab to RSVP!

title: Engineering All-Hands: Migrating to Vite & Tailwind v3
body: Our core software templates have been completely migrated to Vite + React 18 + Tailwind v3. This setup provides up to 10x faster hot reloads during development. SRE and SDE teams will lead a training workshop tomorrow at 3 PM to show best practices and share template code. All engineers are expected to attend.

title: Q1 ARR Growth Celebration & Milestone Achievement
body: We have officially crossed our global sales ARR growth targets for Q1 2026! A huge congratulations to the Sales & Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams who worked tirelessly to close the new Enterprise accounts. We will host a celebratory champagne toast in all office hubs on Friday at 4 PM local time.

title: Welcoming Six New Teammates Across Three Regions
body: Please join us in welcoming Raj Kumar, Maya Singh, James Park, Nina Petrov, Diego Alvarez, and Aisha Khan to the PULSE family this month. Our footprint now spans 11 offices across 4 continents — say hi when you see them in the directory and on Slack!

title: Engineering: Argo CD Rollback Workflow Now Self-Serve
body: James Park rolled out the automated staging rollback flow today. What used to take 40 minutes of checklist work is now a single Argo CD click. Documentation is in the Engineering knowledge hub — try it out on your next deployment and report any rough edges in #eng-platform.

title: Summer Hackathon — Theme & Sign-ups Open
body: Our annual summer hackathon kicks off June 14th with this year's theme: **"Productivity for Everyone"**. Cross-functional teams of 3-5, 48 hours, and prizes for both technical execution and customer impact. Sign-ups open today in the Events tab. New hires — this is your chance to ship something with the whole company watching!

title: Updated Travel & Expense Policy — Effective June 1
body: Finance is rolling out an updated T&E policy effective June 1, 2026. Headline changes: per diem rates now indexed to local cost-of-living, simplified receipt thresholds (>$50 requires receipt, down from $25), and a faster 5-day reimbursement SLA. Full policy doc is in the Finance section of the Knowledge Hub.
